svg.text: JS16660: target TWC vs competitor QTIE (ground-truth label for TWC PRESENT; among the 3 lowest single-vs-contrastive window correlation, correct prediction; window corr -0.75)
f_c(x) = 1.72, f_k(x) = 1.61, margin M(x) = 0.11; zero-baseline margin 6.88; contrastive IG completeness error 1.1% of M(x)-M(0)
A. Input (filtered, z-scored); shaded: 4 windows with the highest CONTRASTIVE (margin) attribution
B. Single-class IG for TWC (logit f_c) - red raises, blue lowers; same colour scale in B and C
C. Contrastive IG for TWC vs QTIE (margin f_c - f_k) - red raises, blue lowers; same colour scale in B and C
colour scale +/-0.165 logit units per 20-sample block (99.5th percentile over both maps)
D. Window evidence for the margin (contrastive IG)
250 ms windows (0-10 s). Red up: evidence for the target over the competitor; blue down: evidence for the competitor.
sum positive 46.21, sum negative -52.91, net -6.70 (= M(x) - M(0) up to IG error)
grey: single-class sum; colour: contrastive sum
Attribution describes the MODEL's sensitivity along the zero-baseline path; it is not evidence of a physiological cause. No region is labelled with a clinical finding.
